Metadata.title: Exam Evaluation Platform
Metadata.description: An intelligent platform that analyzes exam papers, identifies competencies, and turns every assessment into a real learning tool.

Hero.headline: Reinventing university assessment
Hero.subheadlineLine1: An intelligent platform that analyzes exam papers,
Hero.subheadlineLine3: and turns every assessment into a real learning tool.

Reassurance.headline: AI under human control, at every step
Reassurance.subheadline: Every AI-generated evaluation remains verifiable, contestable, and editable by the instructor.

analysis.title: Assisted analysis
analysis.description: The AI structures, extracts, and evaluates each exam paper according to the instructor's rubric.

validation.title: Human validation
validation.description: Any dispute or ambiguity is arbitrated by the instructor — never settled by the AI alone.

traceability.title: Full traceability
traceability.description: Every decision, correction, and grade remains reviewable and justified at any time.

HowItWorks.headline: How it works
HowItWorks.subheadline: A clear, automated 4-step pipeline where you remain in control of every decision.

step1.title: Immediate, no waiting
step1.description: Every submitted paper is picked up right away — analysis starts with no delay, no queue to manage.

step2.title: Structured by the method
step2.description: The content is parsed and organized according to the course's C2PCT method, criterion by criterion, without ever losing the thread of reasoning.

step3.title: The human stays in control
step3.description: The AI proposes, the human decides — never the other way around. The slightest ambiguous case is always settled by the instructor.

step4.title: Feedback that drives progress
step4.description: The student receives a detailed evaluation, designed to help them understand their mistake — not just to penalize it.

CompetencyWheel.headline: Evaluated competencies
CompetencyWheel.subheadline: A methodology developed by Hasnââ Chaabi, Ph.D. Eng., offering a structured framework to develop and analyze computational thinking and reasoning processes.

FinalCta.headline: Reinvent your grading today
FinalCta.subheadline: Join the instructors taking back control of assessment, with AI as a co-pilot — never as a judge.
